name: needs_user_keeps
spec: "needs-user" (the run waits for the candidate's answer to a question, then continues in the same tab) → keep

name: blocked_keeps
spec: "blocked" or "dry-run" (the run reached the Review page and waits for a reviewer's check before submit) → keep

name: dry_run_keeps
spec: "blocked" or "dry-run" (the run reached the Review page and waits for a reviewer's check before submit) → keep

name: captcha_keeps
spec: "captcha" (the candidate must solve a CAPTCHA in that tab) → keep

name: submitted_closes
spec: Every other end state closes the tab: "submitted", ...

name: already_submitted_closes
spec: Every other end state closes the tab: ..., "already-submitted", ...

name: unconfirmed_closes
spec: "unconfirmed" (submit clicked, confirmation is checked by e-mail)

name: handoff_closes
spec: "handoff" (stopped on an error; it is retried fresh later)

name: needs_user_underscore_closes
spec: or any unknown status string (only the exact string "needs-user" is listed as keep)

name: reviewing_near_miss_closes
spec: or any unknown status string (only the exact string "review" is listed as keep)

name: timeout_near_miss_closes
spec: or any unknown status string (only the exact string "login-timeout" is listed as keep)

name: uppercase_submitted_closes
why: The spec lists lowercase "submitted" and says any unknown status string closes; it never states whether matching is case-sensitive, so "SUBMITTED" is treated as an unknown string that closes.
